Every item here keeps alerts reliable. Tap Open settings to fix one; this list rechecks when you come back.
Lets you answer a page with one tap on a locked phone. Android cannot report the per-app setting, so this is a best guess: make sure this app\u2019s notifications are allowed on the lock screen.
Urgent pages can take over the screen, even on the lock screen.
Urgent pages break through Do Not Disturb and set the alarm volume.
Urgent pages ignore Do Not Disturb

Do Not Disturb access has to be on before Android lets the urgent-page notifications break through. If this stays red after you grant it, open the setting and turn on Override Do Not Disturb for urgent pages.
Stops Doze and battery savers from delaying alerts.
Some phone makers add their own background limits. Android cannot report them, so follow the steps below once.
The app declares the microphone and alert service types. The services themselves arrive in a later update.
Settings, Battery, Background usage limits, Never sleeping apps: add Family PTT.
Settings, Apps, Manage apps, Family PTT: turn on Autostart and set Battery saver to No restrictions.
Settings, Apps, Manage apps, Family PTT, Other permissions: allow Show on lock screen.
Settings, Battery, App launch, Family PTT: choose Manage manually and allow all three options.
Settings, Battery, Family PTT: allow background activity and auto-launch.
Settings, Battery, Background power consumption, Family PTT: allow high background power consumption.
Another phone for someone in the family
On the new phone, open the app and scan this code. It only works for one phone and expires in 24 hours. Leaving this screen cancels it.
